title: The King of Fighters '96
note: Name of the character currently fighting next to P1, P2 or CPU (team read from RAM, FBNeo cheat codes), super gauge (MAME cheat database).

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

health.note: health bar in %, full = 103 (cheat database); a K.O. takes its 16-bit word below zero, its high byte at 0xFF (RetroAchievements code notes, lose = ff), which read as a full bar and hid every K.O. (Seb, 1.31): from 0x80 it reads empty

health_p2.note: health bar in %, full = 103 (cheat database); a K.O. takes its 16-bit word below zero, its high byte at 0xFF (RetroAchievements code notes, lose = ff), which read as a full bar and hid every K.O. (Seb, 1.31): from 0x80 it reads empty

_time_sub.note: the timer's fraction of a second (RetroAchievements code notes, 0xa836 Timer: Millseconds), it moves at every frame once the round's timer runs, FIGHT ! waits for it to come with the game's own FIGHT or GO (1.31.1)

score.note: player 1 score, same place as in KOF 98 (identical player record), to be confirmed in game

score_p2.note: player 2 score, same place as in KOF 98 (identical player record), to be confirmed in game

beat.note: VS match, player 1 win streak (BEAT BY at the top of the screen), to find with learn.bat (beat=...)

beat_p2.note: VS match, player 2 win streak (BEAT BY at the top of the screen), to find with learn.bat (beat2=...)

round.note: round of the match, from 0, one more at each K.O. (cheat database "Select Current Round", 1 to 6, as in The King of Fighters '98 where Seb saw it move at each K.O. in 1.31), shown as ROUND n when the next fight begins

backdrop.note: backdrop of the fight (cheat database "Select Backdrop"): 0 Japan Team, 1 Fatal Fury Team, 2 Art of Fighting Team, 3 Ikari Team, 4 Psycho Soldier Team, 5 Gals Fighters Team, 6 Korea Team, 7 Iori Team, 8 Boss Team, 9 Chizuru, 10 Goenitz. Picks the HD theme in "hd": "stages"

power.note: super gauge of player 1 in %, full = 0x80 (MAME cheat database)

power_p2.note: super gauge of player 2 in %, full = 0x80 (MAME cheat database)

_screen.note: the screen the game shows (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x8502 Screen ID (16bit)?, bb7e = Character select, f2e6 = Fighting); its select screens give VS and no event of a fight (1.31.1, K.O. audit), to confirm in game

hd.note: HD screen theme for each backdrop value (index = value), see README, HD themes
